from solution import empty_dit


def test_issue_three_empty_dicts():
    """Check whether all dictionaries in a list are empty: [{},{},{}] is True."""
    assert empty_dit([{},{},{}]) == True  # 3/3 empty -> True


def test_issue_single_empty_dict():
    """Check whether all dictionaries in a list are empty: single empty is True."""
    assert empty_dit([{}]) == True  # 1/1 empty -> True


def test_issue_single_nonempty_dict():
    """Check whether all dictionaries in a list are empty: single nonempty is False."""
    assert empty_dit([{"a": 1}]) == False  # 0/1 empty -> False


def test_issue_two_nonempty_dicts():
    """Check whether all dictionaries in a list are empty: two nonempties is False."""
    assert empty_dit([{"a": 1}, {"b": 2}]) == False  # 0/2 empty -> False


def test_issue_empty_first_nonempty_second():
    """Check whether all dictionaries in a list are empty: mixed empty then nonempty is False."""
    assert empty_dit([{}, {"a": 1}]) == False  # 1/2 empty -> False


def test_issue_nonempty_first_empty_second():
    """Check whether all dictionaries in a list are empty: mixed nonempty then empty is False."""
    assert empty_dit([{"a": 1}, {}]) == False  # 1/2 empty -> False


def test_issue_empty_list():
    """Check whether all dictionaries in a list are empty: empty list is vacuously True."""
    assert empty_dit([]) == True  # 0/0 empty -> True


def test_issue_dict_with_falsy_value_is_nonempty():
    """Check whether all dictionaries in a list are empty: {'a': 0} still counts as nonempty."""
    assert empty_dit([{"a": 0}]) == False  # 0/1 empty -> False


def test_contract_true_result_is_bool():
    """Check whether all dictionaries are empty or not must return a bool True."""
    result = empty_dit([{}, {}])  # 2/2 empty -> True
    assert result is True  # expected literal True


def test_contract_false_result_is_bool():
    """Check whether all dictionaries are empty or not must return a bool False."""
    result = empty_dit([{}, {"a": 1}])  # 1/2 empty -> False
    assert result is False  # expected literal False
